decisions.reason: The existing message-54 MODIFY already records consistent SMASH ROOM branding across locations; no additional update or removal is required.
The existing message-54 INTRODUCE already records dedicated location pages and consistent cross-location design and branding.
Easy reuse for future location sites does not alter the master site's national role or its booking arrangement.
The future-template decision does not change the selector's routing behavior, and the current-location list does not preclude adding future options.
The existing message-54 MODIFY already records cross-location design consistency along with the stated visual design rules.
Reusable page design and consistent branding do not change the requirement that operational locations use separate Wix sites and accounts.
Future location reuse does not modify the already recorded mobile-friendly design requirement.
Message 54 does not change package or pricing policy; consistent branding and redesign-free reuse leave those rules unchanged.
The future-location template decision does not alter the master homepage's recorded sections or offering visibility.
The source decision concerns reusable location-site design and does not change Wix booking hosting or master-site booking behavior.
The future-location template and branding-consistency decision does not modify the Bay Area SEO-preservation goal.
Consistent frontend branding and reusable templates do not alter the requirement for independent location payment setups and payouts.
